    """Generates a list of prime numbers up to 'limit' using the Sieve of Eratosthenes algorithm."""
    is_prime = [True] * (limit + 1)

def is_prime(n):
    # Corner cases: 0 and 1 are not prime
    if n <= 1:
        return False

    # 2 is the only even prime number
    if n == 2:
        return True

    # rules out odd numbers greater than 2
    if n % 2 == 0:
        return False

    # Check for factors greater than sqrt(n)
    # If any factor is found, return False
    for i in range(3, math.isqrt(n) + 1, 2):
        if n % i == 0:
            return False

    # If no factors are found, return True
    return True
